from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u071/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-e2e86a05.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full monochrome divider separates two equally sized patterns.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
            if len(top) == len(bottom):
                return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    for c in range(cols):
        col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rows)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1 and col[0] != 0:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
            if all(len(a) == len(b) for a, b in zip(left, right)):
                return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError('No matching divider')
'''
